wgpu-hal 30.0.1 — retained third-party dependency (MIT OR Apache-2.0)

Source: https://crates.io/crates/wgpu-hal/30.0.1
Upstream repository: https://github.com/gfx-rs/wgpu
Archive SHA256: b6b7fb58561a792bc237628ba0792e332de418fefe145f13b5ed8201e6d52f58
Original license texts: LICENSE.MIT and LICENSE.APACHE (retained unchanged).

FilmCraft patch: enable the existing CAMetalLayer drawable timeout on macOS only.
The setting is applied during each surface configuration, preserving upstream policy on other
Apple platforms. A safe private helper and macOS native-property regression cover initial
configuration and reconfiguration. No new unsafe block, OS binding, or project FFI is added.
Upstream dependency implementation remains outside FilmCraft's workspace; AGENTS.md is unchanged.

The native property test fails with upstream's false policy and passes with the patch. It does
not prove drawable starvation was reproduced or that driver/kernel stalls cannot occur. Apple
documents roughly one second then nil when the timeout is enabled; the existing backend maps
nil to SurfaceError::Timeout. Existing occlusion handling remains intact.
https://developer.apple.com/documentation/quartzcore/cametallayer/allowsnextdrawabletimeout

Packaging changes: upstream Cargo.lock omitted (the product uses its root Cargo.lock); standalone
workspace and ignore rules permit isolated dependency testing without changing the product lock.
All other published package files remain unchanged. Do not edit the global Cargo registry.
